For mu=-1-t,t>0, independently re-derived and checked full exact sextic factorization (g(g(x))-x)(1+x²)H_t=x(mu-1)(x-1)²Q_t. Q_t(0)<0, Q_t(-1/(1+t))>0, Q_t(-infty)<0 provide >=2 distinct negative roots. Q_t(-u) coefficient signs descending are (-,-,-,-,*,+,-), exactly two Descartes sign changes for any t>0: at most two negative roots including multiplicity; hence exactly two simple negative roots corresponding to two distinct primitive cycles. Independent symbolic scale limits Q_t(sqrt(t)u)/t→16u²-1, e²Q_{e^4}(v/e)→-v²(v²-4)(v²+4), and outer next coefficient 128(w-2)e confirm inner -sqrt(t)/4 and outer -2t^-1/4+2; applying g gives displayed positive partners.
